import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
a = df[df.account_id=='frHBxlu'].copy()
base_dates = [d for d in pd.date_range('2025-10-01','2025-10-12')]
an = a[a.date=='2025-10-13']
b = a[a.date.isin(base_dates)]
print("total anomaly:", an.unblended_cost.sum(), "baseline mean daily:", b.unblended_cost.sum()/12, "delta:", an.unblended_cost.sum()-b.unblended_cost.sum()/12)
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    g_an = an.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()
    g_b = b.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/12
    d = pd.concat([g_an, g_b], axis=1).fillna(0)
    d.columns=['anom','base']
    d['delta']=d.anom-d.base
    d=d.reindex(d.delta.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index)
    print("\n==", col, "==")
    print(d.head(12).round(2).to_string())
    print("top-3 abs delta sum:", d.delta.abs().nlargest(3).sum().round(2), "| largest positive deltas:", d[d.delta>0].delta.nlargest(5).round(2).to_dict())
